# Fuel Rod
A Zircaloy Tube in the middle of a crafting grid with eight Fuel Pellets round it, all of one enrichment. A rod records its fuel (uranium oxide for now), its enrichment, its burnup, the plutonium and fission products it has built up, and its decay heat.
Fresh rods are only mildly radioactive.

# Burnup
In the core a rod uses up its U-235 and builds up fission products, which absorb neutrons, and some plutonium, which fissions too. At full power a rod lasts about four hours. Spent rods come out intensely radioactive and hot: their decay heat burns bare hands until it fades. Keep them in a Lead Box.
# Control Rod
Silver between steel rods: a strong neutron absorber, for Control Rod Channels.
